Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
1058 PM EDT Fri Oct 16 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 6 AM EDT SATURDAY...
...GALE WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 6 AM EDT SATURDAY THROUGH LATE
SATURDAY NIGHT...

.REST OF TONIGHT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves
2 to 3 ft. Scattered showers with a slight chance of tstms late this
evening, then showers. 
.SAT...N winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts to 35 kt. Waves 4 ft. Numerous
showers. 
.SAT NIGHT...N winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.SUN...NE winds 20 to 25 kt. Gusts up to 30 kt in the morning. Waves
3 ft. 
.SUN NIGHT...NE winds 15 to 20 kt...increasing to 25 to 30 kt after
midnight. Waves 3 ft. 
.MON...N winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. A chance of showers. 
.MON NIGHT...N winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 4 ft. A chance of showers. 
.TUE...N winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. A chance of showers in the
morning. 
.WED...NE winds 20 to 25 kt. Waves 3 ft. A chance of showers through
the night.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
